# replace 63658 with the actual port printed by the client (no $PID variable)
Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 63690 | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,RemoteAddress,RemotePort,State,OwningProcess

# then show the process command line
(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$((Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 63690).OwningProcess)") |
  Select-Object ProcessId,Name,CommandLine | Format-List
